name: Armour of Contempt
description: When your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, target one Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of that unit's attacks. Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the Armour Penetration of attacks that target your unit by 1.

name: Blitzing Fusillade
description: When your Shooting phase, target one Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot. Until the end of the phase, its ranged weapons have [ASSAULT]; a weapon that already has [ASSAULT] also gains [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

name: Full Throttle
description: When your Movement phase, target one Adeptus Astartes Mounted or Vehicle unit (excluding Walkers). Until the end of the phase, if it Advances, do not roll: add 6" to its Move, or 9" if it is Mounted.

name: Shock Assault
description: When your Charge phase, target one Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that has not declared a charge. Until the end of the turn, you can re-roll its Charge rolls and its melee weapons have [LANCE].

name: Ride Hard, Ride Fast
description: When your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, target one Adeptus Astartes Mounted or Fly Vehicle unit selected as a target. Until the end of the phase, attacks targeting it suffer -1 to Hit and -1 to Wound.

name: Wind-swift Evasion
description: When your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, target one Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Mounted unit within 9" of it that is not within Engagement Range. It can make a Normal move of up to 6".
